text: Of what Isaac knows the narrator says nothing. He carries the wood; he asks where the lamb is; he receives a reply which answers nothing he asked. No interior is given him, only a verb: they went, both of them, together. The phrase recurs, and the repetition stands in the place of an explanation. The question of his consent is raised and then quietly laid aside, unresolved; obedience settles the whole account, and leaves nothing unaccounted for.
